title: Hatsune Miku — The SEKAI Dressing Room Is This Way♪〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: The SEKAI Dressing Room Is This Way♪（4★）

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm glad Shizuku was back to smiling again.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me too♪ I have a feeling Shizuku's gonna come up with a really good design now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I can't wait to see it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(We believe in you, Shizuku.
We'll be rooting for you from SEKAI.)
Dressing Room

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
At the same time...
I sort of can't believe how many outfits we have now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It just dawned on me while I was showing Shizuku around.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, me too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. That may be because I arrived here only recently and added my outfits to the pile.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, maybe. Hm?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Miku, look!
Isn't this what we wore during our first show together?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It is! Hehe. Remember the dance we did? The one where we twirled around while holding each other's hands?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I do! We twirled around so much that we still couldn't see straight when we tried to start our second song.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. That really happened?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Would you mind telling me more about some of the things that happened when you wore these outfits on stage?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Of course.
Next, we can...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, how about these?
We usually wear them when we know we're going to do a duet or song for couples.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And it looks like it's designed to match your hair color, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Mine's the same♪
Not only that, each outfit's color-coded in a special way♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Take a look at the cuffs and collar. Oh, the skirt too.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You're right. These certainly look like they've been made with duets and other romantic songs in mind.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, KAITO.
Can we hear some stories about your outfits?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanna hear too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You do? In that case... Oh, how about this one?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa! The wings on the shoulders look so fluffy! They're so stylish and cool!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They are, but... I'm not sure I've ever seen you wear that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. This is actually one of my more extravagant outfits in my wardrobe. I'll wear it when I feel the time is right.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really? Like for a special occasion?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. Also, the wings and other decorations you see on it are very delicate.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Much more fragile compared to any of the other outfits I have, so it's in safe-keeping for now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Our shows usually involve us dancing and running around all over the stage.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: As a result, anything attached to our hips or shoulders ends up falling off more than the other parts.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah. I know exactly what you mean.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me! I accidentally stepped on the hem of my dress this one time and caused some of the lace to tear.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I really liked that dress because of how cute it was too. I had it mended so that I could wear it one last time, but I don't know where I put it...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, that's like my outfit with a loose button.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I remember getting one of my outfits all dirty after tripping while trying to exit the stage.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No, it's not this one...
Huh? The sequins on the arm for this one are gone!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...
It won't be stage ready until those are reattached.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I was thinking about wearing it for my next show...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You've both done so many shows already, so it's honestly no surprise that some of your outfits need mending.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But we'll both shine on stage again if it does get mended!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. It should be doable as long as it's nothing major.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'd like to give it a try if you think it's possible!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: These outfits are a large part of why we're able to shine on stage as idols after all.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, why don't we also ask Luka and the others to join us for our little inventory check?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If I recall correctly, we're supposed to all meet sometime soon. I'll be sure to check your schedules later.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's KAITO for you! An idol and a manager!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I really appreciate it, KAITO!
For now, why don't we go let Luka and the others know?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sounds good♪
